examples.title: Split baskets need two delivery checks

One hundred millilitres at a time Illustrative example: R24 for 400 millilitres is R6 per hundred millilitres. R35 for 500 millilitres is R7 per hundred millilitres. Unit prices make different sizes easier to compare when the products are equivalent. Refill packs need a fair comparison A refill pouch can look cheaper because the sticker price is lower. Match the product and compare the price per millilitre.
